# cloudaxion Provider

Manage CloudAxion infrastructure — the Tunisian cloud operated by DataXion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cloudaxion = {
      source  = "zorgatia/cloudaxion"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials come from the environment:
#   CLOUDAXION_API_KEY            API token created in the CloudAxion web interface
#   CLOUDAXION_LOCATION           default location slug
#   CLOUDAXION_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID billing account charged for created resources
provider "cloudaxion" {}

# Or set them explicitly. Keep api_key out of version control.
provider "cloudaxion" {
  alias              = "explicit"
  location           = "tun1"
  billing_account_id = 12
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) CloudAxion API token, sent as the `apikey` header. Prefer the `CLOUDAXION_API_KEY` environment variable over writing it into configuration.
- `billing_account_id` (Number) Default billing account charged for created resources. The API requires this on most create calls. May also be set with `CLOUDAXION_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID`.
- `endpoint` (String) API root. Defaults to `https://api.cloudaxion.net/v1`, or the `CLOUDAXION_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `location` (String) Default location slug (see the `cloudaxion_locations` data source). Location-scoped resources use it unless they set their own. When empty, the API acts on the account's default location. May also be set with `CLOUDAXION_LOCATION`.
